invariants.rationale: A commit action should not proceed with a null instantTime, as it typically identifies a commit moment.
The partitionRecordsMap must not be null to process commit records.
A commit should generally be performed only if there are new records, i.e., the records map is not empty.
Commit instants in Hudi are usually non-empty strings to uniquely identify a commit.
Partition keys in the map should be non-null and non-empty as they represent partition identifiers.
